notes: Faces look like the game again: the head is the classic shape rounded off to match the body, with the simple face (flat eyes, thick brows, a mouth line), no more uncanny eyeballs and lips. The Black Flash now only goes off when a finisher hits the head; finishers that land elsewhere (the powerbomb, the armbar) get the original black-and-white manga frames with the red flash. The rebirth-3 heavy impact frame is bigger and easier to see.
